limitations: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
Pseudocode is Ghidra decompiler output, not original source and not text-equivalent to Hopper output.
External functions and functions without an analyzable body return null; other decompiler failures remain explicit.

Ghidra Listing reports a terminal call at 0x19f324 to 0x1f7540 <EXTERNAL>::__stack_chk_fail (external=false, thunk=true, hasNoReturn=true); fallthrough is excluded by Ghidra's flow model. This records Ghidra's FunctionManager flag, not an independent verification that the callee cannot return.
macOS sessions require a matching executable Ghidra native decompiler; REA checks for it but does not build native components or change Gatekeeper quarantine state.

native.addressMapping: Original ELF .text VA equals file offset for these ranges; REA maps each at +0x100000. Byte slices verified independently.
native.construction: Count wrapper fixes subfunction01; list wrapper fixes02. Both pass the caller byte mask to the generic helper, which appends19,subfunction,mask. There is no offset or page argument in this path.
native.scope: Stock library construction; neither ECM firmware filtering behavior nor another controller-specific pagination service is established.

retainedObservations.boundary: Different retained requests/times; timeout does not establish unsupported service or no CAN response.

sizeModel.boundary: Original OTA MCU size gate; installed MCU hash and first ECM CAN frame still missing. Not proof of NRC13 origin.

counterexample.result: Two nonempty slices each still contain258 records. No collection of status masks makes them smaller.
counterexample.zeroStatusBoundary: Under status-mask intersection semantics a supported code with status00 appears in no mask slice. A union of memory slices cannot prove the complete19 0A registry.

nextEvidence.memoryReading: A future exact-identity count-first investigation could read an individually supported mask only if the fresh count fits and response validation succeeds; retain each time/status separately. No such pass is implemented or run here.
nextEvidence.doNotRepeat: Do not repeat mask04 timeouts or large FF/0A requests without a new hypothesis. A count before a list is not an atomic size guarantee.
nextEvidence.registry: Need source-qualified controller-specific registry selection or first7E8 CAN reply with matching installed MCU identity; owner03/readback dead ends remain closed.
